title: Errors
description: Stable error categories and the error payload returned by the runtime.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable category. The first six runtime-originated values mirror ErrorCode in virealm-process-runtime; the remaining values are protocol-level categories.

operation.description: Platform API that failed, when the failure came from a platform call.

windowsError.description: Raw Win32 error code. Diagnostic only; do not parse the number to decide behaviour.

errno.description: Raw POSIX errno. Diagnostic only; mutually exclusive with windowsError.

method.description: Printable method name named by an unknown_method error.

supportedProtocolVersion.description: Protocol version this runtime implements, returned with unsupported_protocol_version.

message.description: Short diagnostic description for the caller, not final UI copy and never a raw stack trace.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the exact request is safe. A false value means retry could duplicate a process or repeat a rejected action.
